name: Reference: the weekly price check
goal: Each week, check that every price on the bakery's site matches the price list the baker keeps, and say what differs. The finish line each week is a short report the baker has read. The reader is the baker. A report nobody reads does not count. The quality bar is that no difference is missed, because a missed one is sold at the wrong price; the reviewer owns it. If a week's check cannot be done, what is owed is which prices were not checked and why.
